get.description: The Household's one Shopping List, with its items and Shops (ADR 0009).

put.description: Move an item to the Fridge, Freezer or Cupboard (ADR 0011).

get.description: Starter Ingredients plus the caller's own Household Ingredients (ADR 0012).

post.description:
The Kitchen's "Add 'kale'": the Ingredient this name means for the Household, made
as a Household Ingredient if nothing matches (ADR 0012). 200 either way: asking twice
returns the same Ingredient.

get.description:
With `q`: recipes closest in meaning, best first. Without: all, by title, a page
at a time (`offset`). Search has no pages: past the top results, matches get weak.

schema.title: Response List Or Search Recipes Get
Response List Cuisines Recipes Cuisines Get

put.description: The days the "Plan my week" sheet starts with ticked (ADR 0015).

ChangeSource.title: ChangeSource
ChangeSource.description: What last changed a Kitchen quantity. Feeds the calculated status (ADR 0003).

ConversationIn.title: ConversationIn
ConversationIn.description:
How a plan starts. Both left out for a free chat; the "Plan my week" sheet sends
the kind of plan and the days picked (ADR 0015).

Course.title: Course
Course.description:
What a recipe is for. Exactly one each; plans offer mains, because a Planned Meal
is a dinner (see CONTEXT.md).

DecisionIn.title: DecisionIn
DecisionIn.description:
Approve (optionally with some meals or additions unticked) or reject.

`keep_meals` / `keep_additions` list what stays ticked: dates of proposed meals, and
positions in `list_additions`. Leave one out to keep all of that kind.

DietaryRulesIn.title: DietaryRulesIn
DietaryRulesIn.description: The whole set (PUT replaces it). Unknown diets are rejected, not ignored.

DraftOut.title: DraftOut
DraftOut.description: The Draft Plan as it grows during a turn. Not Household data yet.

EditItemIn.title: EditItemIn
EditItemIn.description:
Only the fields present are changed. Send `null` to clear quantity, unit, the
Ingredient link or the Shop.

MealPlanOut.title: MealPlanOut
MealPlanOut.description: A week of Planned Meals, from `start`. `version` matches the change notices.

PlanMode.title: PlanMode
PlanMode.description: What kind of plan the Member asked for in the "Plan my week" sheet (ADR 0015).

PlanWeekdaysIn.title: PlanWeekdaysIn
PlanWeekdaysIn.description:
The days the Household usually plans. Its own route, so saving them can't
overwrite another Member's change to the rest of the Preferences.

ProposalOut.title: ProposalOut
ProposalOut.description:
What the Member is asked to approve. Meals that broke a Dietary Rule are already
left out and named in `dropped`; `check_label` lists ingredients to check.

ProposalOutcomeOut.title: ProposalOutcomeOut
ProposalOutcomeOut.description: What approving did. `message` is written by code, not the LLM.

SetQuantityIn.title: SetQuantityIn
SetQuantityIn.description: `null` means "we have some; amount not recorded".

TurnEvents.title: TurnEvents
TurnEvents.description:
OpenAPI can't describe a stream, so the docs describe one event. That's enough
for the generated TypeScript to include every event type.
